items.title: Written request ceiling gate
items.context: Any login, OTP, API, messaging, upload, or payment abuse test
items.intended_use: Record a hard cap and stop conditions before sending repeated requests
items.payload: REVIEW-ONLY: stop count = owner-approved small integer
caveats: Never brute-force, spray, spam, flood, or create provider cost
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
